scenarios.preReviewSubject: 15 More Minutes, and a Thank You
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Rachel,

When we spoke in March, you suggested I track a few brands. I'm now tracking three, and it has given my reading a focus it didn't have before. Thank you, too, for pointing me to Ben Ortega.

I'm a consumer sector analyst in Duke Investment Club, and this summer at Pinecrest Wealth Partners I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks used in client portfolio reviews. Following brands closely is a different exercise from screening, and I'm still learning how to do it well.

Would you have 15 minutes to talk? Now that I have three brands to show for your advice, I'd value your view on whether I'm watching the right things. Whatever time suits your calendar is fine with me.

Best,
